preToolUse.bash: mkdir -p logs && HOOK_INPUT=$(cat) && echo "Pre-tool-use hook with args: $HOOK_INPUT" >> logs/session.log
preToolUse.powershell: $hookInput = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path logs -Force | Out-Null; Add-Content -Path logs/session.log -Value "Pre-Tool Use with cwd $PWD and args: $hookInput"
